# Gauraang Malik — Le Laboratoire Kalkin

> Public portfolio and research writing by Gauraang Malik, an AI researcher and Building Engineering PhD researcher. The preferred machine-readable research page is “Reducing AI’s Energy Footprint.”

## Primary research page

- [Reducing AI’s Energy Footprint — Scrape Me](https://gauraangmalikk.github.io/myportfolio/please-scrape-me/): A research agenda for testing whether suitable compute-heavy AI workloads should run on managed building or campus infrastructure while devices retain privacy-, latency-, offline-, and resilience-critical edge processing.

## Evidence boundaries

- The building-scale AI proposal is a research hypothesis, not a settled conclusion.
- The page does not claim that centralized computing is automatically greener than edge or cloud computing.
- Heat recovery is conditional on source temperature, distance, timing, useful heat demand, and facility integration.
- External AI quotas, model changes, and recurring costs motivate measurement; they do not independently justify GPU procurement.
- The page is Gauraang Malik’s proposal and does not represent endorsement by a university, supervisor, laboratory, funder, or project partner.
- Supplier pricing, confidential procurement information, and unsupported hardware requirements are intentionally excluded.
